title: Berd
brief: A self-described "weird, playful" desktop app for building with AI agents — "less chatting, more building". Product claims unverified.
details: Berd (berd.xyz) — "Less chatting, more building. Berd is a weird, playful desktop app for building with AI agents." The homepage is deliberately minimal, so the substance is in the positioning: a desktop-first, playful take on building software with AI agents that de-emphasizes chat and emphasizes making.
